findings.evidence: Couplings.lean:155-173 — three parallel `norm_num [doubletElectricCharge_apply, singletElectricCharge_def]` proofs. Arithmetic: YQ=1/3, isospinWeight 0=1/2 → 1/3+1=4/3=Yu; YQ=1/3, isospinWeight 1=-1/2 → 1/3-1=-2/3=Yd; YL=-1 → -1-1=-2=Ye (Representation.lean:261 `standardModel := ⟨1/3, 4/3, -2/3, -1, -2⟩`), so all three are instances of the single general identity.
findings.fix: Add `doubletElectricCharge_eq_singletElectricCharge_add_two_mul_isospinWeight (y : ℝ) (k : Fin 2) : doubletElectricCharge y k = singletElectricCharge (y + 2 * isospinWeight k)` (proof: `rw [doubletElectricCharge_apply, singletElectricCharge_def]; ring`), and derive the three SM lemmas from it by `norm_num` on the hypercharges (`standardModel.Yu = standardModel.YQ + 2 * isospinWeight 0`, etc.).
findings.issue: `doubletElectricCharge_standardModel_YQ_zero_eq_singletElectricCharge_Yu` (157), `..._YQ_one_eq_singletElectricCharge_Yd` (164) and `..._YL_one_eq_singletElectricCharge_Ye` (171) each re-prove, by a separate `norm_num [doubletElectricCharge_apply, singletElectricCharge_def]`, instances of one general identity: `doubletElectricCharge y k = singletElectricCharge (y + 2 * isospinWeight k)` (equivalently `doubletElectricCharge y k = singletElectricCharge y' ↔ y' = y + 2 * isospinWeight k`). No such general lemma exists (grep for `singletElectricCharge` in `ElectricCharge.lean` shows only `singletElectricCharge`, `singletElectricCharge_def` and the action lemma). Stating only the three SM points hides the mechanism the module docstring appeals to ("what allows a single `Q` in `ofQuantumNumbers`") and does not transfer to the rescaled/swapped anomaly-free assignments `q • standardModel`, `standardModel.swapQuarkSinglets` already in `Representation.lean`.

summary: The coupling functions themselves are at the natural level (functions of (T³, Q, sin²θ_W), no unused or over-strong hypotheses, neutrino derived from the neutral case). The one gap is the doublet/singlet charge-matching fact, proved three times at Standard Model points instead of once in general.
